notes: T2-T5 ran an iceless R&D four times a turn, re-accessing the same top card (about 11 wasted clicks), and T11-T12 repeated HQ runs only re-saw Mindscaping. Never contested the advanced Server 1 card on T2 (Longevity Serum scored T3). T9 Jailbreak facechecked Saisentan with a small grip and T13 facechecked Anemone. Worst of all, T14-T19 it clicked for credits up to 36 with 5 cards in grip while the Corp installed and scored Regenesis (T18) and Project Yagi-Uda (T20, game) from Server 3 without one run.

Sharp tempo game: T1 Sure Gamble into an HQ steal, Pinhole Threading to trash Nico Campaign, then Tread Lightly on Nico T6 and Docklands Pass HQ pressure. Won T7 with the Méliès steal. Only a minor click-for-credit inefficiency on T4.

T1-T2 repeated iceless R&D runs re-seeing the same card. From T3 to T21 it did almost nothing but click for credits (5 to 77) and never installed a card from a 5-card grip. It never re-ran Server 1, even though T1 showed Ballista could not stop a Runner with no programs, while the Corp scored Divested Trust T5, Transport Monopoly T14, Above the Law T16 and Transport Monopoly T22 there.

Good HQ pressure with No Free Lunch, Bravado, Docklands Pass, Overclock and Red Team, winning T8 on a Méliès steal. Minor: T3 drew into a full grip and discarded, and it let the rezzed Otto Campaign in Server 3 run for several turns.

Took some net damage checking remotes on T1-T2 (Mavirus, Urtica Cipher), then built Shibboleth and Revolver T3. Used Carpe Diem, Tread Lightly and Transfer of Wealth runs well, breaking Karunā every time, and won T7 with a Fujii Asset Retrieval steal from R&D.

After Ansel 1.0 trashed Cat's Cradle on T3, it ran into the same unbroken Ansel (which stops steals) 3-4 times per turn on T3-T5 and T13-T18 and T20-T21, while holding 4 cards and 9 credits and never drawing or installing. T19 was the decisive blunder: it ran Server 6 with no Ansel, accessed Méliès City Luxury Line with clicks left and declined to spend a click to steal it, which was a win at 4 points. It did this three times, and the Corp scored that Méliès on T21.

Buzzsaw on Descent and Banner on Tree Line gave reliable access, and it won T16 on an SDS Drone Deployment steal. But it was slow: T5-T7 and T9 were mostly click-for-credit turns, it held a full grip for long stretches, and it left an extra click unused for runs on T3 and T8.

T1-T2 ran an iceless R&D four times a turn, re-seeing the same card. From T4 to T16 it clicked for credits every turn (up to 59) with a 5-card grip and never installed anything. It ran only to trash ZATO (T11) and once into Akhet (T12), and never again as the Corp scored Transport Monopoly T13, Divested Trust T15 and Above the Law T17 from Server 3.

Spent T2 to 0 credits with Mayfly to reach a non-agenda (Federal Fundraising). On T7 it ran into the known Mestnichestvo with 6 credits but did not break it with Unity. T10 left a 2-advanced Server 2 card alone (Next Big Thing scored T11). With 5 points, T11 R&D runs 3-4 re-saw the same card. T12-T16 it clicked for credits up to 25 instead of pressuring HQ/R&D, then bounced off Ping on T17 and the Corp won with Next Big Thing T18.

Aggressive and effective against NBN: R&D steal T2, Mayfly through Mestnichestvo for Tomorrow's Headline T4, then deep remote runs T7-T8 with Gauss and Unity for the win. It left several tags unremoved, which was risky against a tag deck, and it took Unsmiling Tsarevna net damage on T7-T8, but the result justified it.

Solid R&D focus with Unity on Mestnichestvo and steady tag clearing, winning T13 on a Next Big Thing steal. The T10 R&D facecheck at 2 credits cost 2 cards to Unsmiling Tsarevna, and T13 re-ran the known Tsarevna with a small grip.

After bouncing off Akhet in Server 1 on T6, it never ran that server again. It spent 14-19 credits on connections and economy (The Twinning, Trickster Taka, Cookbook, Paladin Poemu, Bling, Mystic Maemi) while the Corp scored Above the Law T7, Transport Monopoly T9, Above the Law T12 and Transport Monopoly T14 from the same remote. T10 drew into a full grip and discarded 2.

T1-T2 ran an iceless R&D four times a turn, mostly re-seeing the same card. After bouncing off Mestnichestvo on T6 and T8 it clicked for credits on T7 and T9-T13 (up to 36) with a full grip and no breakers installed. The Corp scored Embedded Reporting T10, Tomorrow's Headline T11 and Embedded Reporting T15 from Server 3 with no further runs there.

Against a Jinteki net-damage deck it ran through Anemone repeatedly (T2-T5, T8) to re-access known non-agendas (Moon Pool, Urtica Cipher), losing Sure Gamble and Docklands Pass, and never built an economy. On T9 it facechecked Server 2 with 3 cards (another Anemone emptied the grip), then ran into the known HQ Anemone with 0 cards and flatlined.

Went broke T1 on Tremolo and Red Team and lost cards to Mavirus checking remotes, but Shibboleth on Hafrún opened HQ for Regenesis, two Longevity Serums and an Archives Hybrid Release. It won T8 with Fujii Asset Retrieval via Docklands Pass.

After Ansel 1.0 trashed Marjanah on T1, it looped unbroken Ansel runs on Server 1 and HQ (3-4 per turn on T1-T4 and T11-T16) that could never steal, and also repeated R&D runs that re-saw the same card (T5, T8-T10). It never drew or installed a breaker from its grip, and the Corp scored Project Ingatan T3, Megaprix T5, Ingatan T15 and Ingatan T17 from that one Ansel remote.

Banner on Akhet gave steady R&D access and the game was won T14. But on T3 and T6 it clicked for credits and draws while holding 13-15 credits, it could not get through Descent on the Server 1 and Server 2 remotes (SDS Drone Deployment scored T8), and it fell to 1-3 credits late.

At 4 points on T4 and again T5, the first HQ run reached Méliès City Luxury Line with clicks remaining (Vertigo's no-steal effect did not trigger), and it declined to spend a click to steal it, a game-winning steal both times. It then looped unbroken Ansel 1.0 runs on Server 5 (T13-T17) that lost Carmen, Cat's Cradle, Marjanah and Pennyshaver, while the Corp scored Méliès T17 and Project Ingatan T18.

Clean game: Carmen broke Ansel 1.0 on R&D, it trashed Nico Campaigns, and steady HQ pressure plus Docklands Pass stole Megaprix, ADT and two Ingatans for a T9 win. Minor: T7 paid 5 for a second Red Team.

T1-T2 ran an iceless R&D four times a turn, re-seeing the same card, instead of checking the fresh Server 1 install (Divested Trust scored T2). After bouncing off Tree Line on T4 and Afshar on T8 it clicked for credits on T5-T12 (up to 46) with a full grip and never installed anything. The Corp scored Above the Law T5 and T9 and Transport Monopoly T13 uncontested.
